visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a grey Yankees baseball cap and a black face mask stands in a brightly lit airport terminal. She holds up her smartphone, showing a digital flight itinerary while gesturing with her free hand. Behind her is a check-in counter and several other travelers. (2) A brief black transition screen appears with white text in the center. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a check-in counter where airline staff hands are seen processing documents. The woman is visible in a small circular inset, looking anxious. (4) The woman is now holding two green boarding passes in front of the camera, her eyes crinkling as if smiling behind her mask. The background shows the check-in area and signage. (5) A wide shot of the airport security area follows, showing a long line of people waiting. The woman stands in the foreground, gesturing towards the priority lane. (6) The scene changes to the interior of an airport lounge with modern seating and a food station. A man in a beige hoodie, his face obscured by a bear emoji, is seen sitting and eating. (7) The final phase shows the woman walking into a spacious airplane business class cabin with large green pod seats. She films her companion settling into his seat as a flight attendant in a green uniform serves them.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female vlogger, 1 male companion, at least 3 airline staff members, and over 10 other passengers in background shots.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman wearing a grey cap, a black mask, and a dark blue cardigan. A man wearing a light beige hoodie.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves through an airport terminal with check-in desks and baggage belts, a crowded security screening area, a quiet luxury airport lounge with snacks, and finally the interior of a commercial airplane's business class cabin.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic female voice speaking Chinese over a high-tempo synth-pop BGM. The voice is enthusiastic with a high pitch contour. Faint airport terminal hum is audible in the background. (2) A rhythmic heartbeat SFX pulses briefly as the music ducks, creating a sense of tension. (3) The female narrator's voice returns, accompanied by the sound of rapid keyboard typing and paper rustling at a service counter. The upbeat BGM swells back to full volume. (4) A high-pitched 'Ding' SFX marks a transition to an even more excited vocal delivery. The female speaker expresses joy. Ambient chatter from the terminal is low. (5) Transition to the lounge area is marked by a softer ambient noise floor. A male voice is heard responding with a satisfied, low-arousal tone. The sound of a spoon clinking against a bowl is clearly audible. (6) The final phase features a steady airplane cabin hum (low-frequency noise floor). A female flight attendant's voice is heard speaking polite English in the distance. The primary narrator closes with a cheerful sign-off as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the vlogger's successful experience with an airline upgrade. It builds tension by mentioning previous failures, reveals the success at the check-in counter, and then showcases the luxury benefits of business class, including lounge access, priority security, and superior cabin seating.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of EVA AIR logos, boarding passes, and positive coverage of their business class service and airport lounge experience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-energy travel vlog effectively using text overlays and upbeat music to share a personal 'success story' of a flight upgrade.
